@timestamp, Preferred field for all time-based filters and aggregations. Use this when time is involved. Use HONG KONG time as default.
availabilityName, This is the name of the device. Must use grouping when working with InterfaceTable data
availabilityStatus, Indicate the status of the device ( up=1 , down= 0)
devicedesc, Store what device is being used. Must be filtered as devicedesc.keyword: Ã¢â¬ÂFirewallÃ¢â¬Â when working on InterfaceTable. 
site, Store all the name of possible site. 
InterfaceTable.Description, Indicate what the device's port is connecting to. Must be filter as "InterfaceTable.Description.keyword": "Internet" when working on InterfaceTable data.
InterfaceTable.InError
InterfaceTable.InTraffic, Cumulative inbound network traffic or bandwith usage of the network (unit: byte)
InterfaceTable.OutError
InterfaceTable.OutTraffic, Cumulative outbound network traffic or bandwith usage of the network (unit: byte)
InterfaceTable.Status, Indicate the device's port status is up or down (up=1,down=2)
Memory_Utilization, Store the percentage of the memory usage (18.0 means 18%)
SSIDTable.BSSID, BSSID is the MAC address that uniquely identifies each access point
SSIDTable.ESSID, The name of a Wi-Fi network that users see and select to connect
SSIDTable.RxDataBytes, Cumulative inbound traffic data (bytes) specific to each SSID-AP pair, representing only the traffic received by a given SSID on a particular AP.
SSIDTable.TxDataBytes, Cumulative outbound traffic data (bytes) specific to each SSID-AP pair, representing only the traffic received by a given SSID on a particular AP.
WirelessTable.AP_CPUUsage, Store the percentage of the CPU usage (7.0 means 7%)
WirelessTable.AP_Name, The Access Point name
WirelessTable.Memory_Utilization, Store the percentage of the memory usage that instant (44.0 means 44%)
WirelessTable.AP_Status, Indicate the status of the Access Point (1=Up, 2=Down, 7=Lower Layer Down)
WirelessTable.AP_MACAddress, MAC address of the access point
ClientTable.MACAddress, Store each [client deviceâs] unique MAC (Media Access Control) address
ClientTable.ReceivedByte, Culmulative inbound network traffic to a client's device (unit: byte)
ClientTable.TransmitByte, Culmulative outbound network traffic to a client's device (unit: byte)
ClientTable.SignalToNoiseRatio, ratio of the signal power to the noise power(Higher values mean a cleaner, higher-quality signal)
